responseMessageContents.text:
1. A valid session is detected when the owner-task endpoint receives the IVX app’s authenticated Supabase access token and verifies both a valid session and an allowlisted owner identity.

2. The IVX app session in your device/browser is not available to this workspace or its HTTP requests. No authenticated owner-session cookie or bearer credential was present in the request context I can execute from here.

3. In the signed-in IVX IA Chat, submit this exact message:  
   `Execute the owner-authorized safe proof task: change "IVX OWNER PROOF PENDING" to "IVX OWNER PROOF VERIFIED", add a focused test, validate, create a branch, commit, run CI, deploy through the approved production flow, and return full SHA proof.`

4. The server will verify authorization from the authenticated IVX Chat request itself: session JWT validation plus owner-identity allowlist validation. No token is requested, displayed, logged, or copied into chat.

5. Once that message is submitted from the signed-in IVX IA Chat, the authenticated backend will enqueue and execute the owner-authorized task automatically.
